THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompanies thisorder exists between,
Mr. S. C. L. K. Wickramaratne, Konegahawatta, Kudagama, Dombemada, Rambukkana, of the one part
and
The Employees' Trust Fund Board, 1st Floor, Labour Secretariat, P. O. Box 807, Colombo 05, of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vestedin me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amendedby Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes-Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr.R. S. Ariyapperuma, No. 03, Araliya Mawatha, Sirimal Uyana, Ratmalana, to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to himfor settlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.Colombo.29th December, 2016.

STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE

The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties isWhether the appointment given to Mr. S. C. L. K. Wickramaratne to act in the post of Manager - Grade II of the Employees' Trust Fund Board,not being backdated on permanent basis with effect from 01.08.2009 is just and if not so, to what reliefs he is entitled.
M. D. C. AMARATHUNGA,Commissioner of Labour.Dated at the office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 18th day of November, 2016.

STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE

The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties isWhether the termination of Mrs. G.D. Gnanasaundary who worked Pimburawatta, Agalawatta owned by Agalawatta Plantations PLC, witheffect from 08.04.2014, victimizing her for a theft of rubber latex which had occured on 20.01.2014 is unjust and in equitable and if so, to whatreliefs she is entitled.M. NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 if 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 herebyappoint

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. W. L. A. de Silva, No. 667/32-A, 5th Lane, Yatihena, Waduwegama, Malwana, of the one part
AND
Ceylon Electricity Board, No. 50, Sir Chittampalam A.Gardiner Mawatha, Colombo 02, of the other part
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the claim made by Mr. W. L.A. de Silva, who worked at the Ceylon Electricity Board that, the period from 01.04.1999 to01.10.2003 during which he was released to the Sapugaskanda Rehabilitation and Maintenance Project should be considered as an activeservice period at the Ceylon Electricity Board and that all allowances including the respective salary scale, salary, pension and gratuityshould be calculated and paid to him is just and if so, to what reliefs he is entitled.
M. D. C. AMARATHUNGA,Commissioner of Labour.
